name: com.streethawk.library.GeofenceService
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Google Play Services starts this StreetHawk Service when a monitored geofence is entered or exited. It updates the saved geofence state and sends qualifying transitions to StreetHawk.
disableEffect: StreetHawk location-triggered campaigns and geofence visit reports will stop responding to boundary changes.
